title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: ‘reiterates the need to avoid fragmentation and maintain the horizontal implementing framework, including overarching rules and principles such as respect for the rule of law and fundamental rights, which should apply uniformly across the policies covered under the NRPP, while ensuring coherent and consistent implementation provisions;’
